role: logic calibration: ES is unprovable in open induction (IOpen)
missing_theorem: No ES yield (meta-theorem). Some discretely ordered ring model of IOpen (Shepherdson's Puiseux model, or a ℤ + T·ℚ[T]-type ring) contains an element n with no positive x, y, z satisfying 4xyz = n(xy + yz + zx). The candidate is n = 840T + 1 or n = (2T+1)², by a Mordell–Schinzel-type argument extended to the model's coefficient ring. Consequence: any ES proof needs non-open induction, i.e. it cannot be a pure 'polynomial in n' argument.

role: decide a linear-divisibility sufficient condition by a local–global principle (Lipshitz/Bel'tyukov)

The primes p ≡ 1 (4) < 1000 where it fails are 73, 193, 313, 337, 409, 457, 577, 673 (checked). Lipshitz's LGP needs hypotheses that such parametric statements violate. Fixed-modulus divisibility events are M2, while ES is tied.

role: calibration only (complexity of the predicate D(N,m) = ∃d | N, d ≡ −1 mod m)
missing_theorem: None. D ∈ NP (certificate d). Given the factorisation of N (verifiable via Pratt certificates), D is decidable in time ≤ τ(N)·poly = N^{o(1)}. A poly-time test from the factorisation is a subset-product problem in (ℤ/m)^×, open in general but irrelevant to ES's truth.
